about: Rook Hill and Kelda's upper stream (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 02, 03 and 05; Stage 14, decisions S14-1, S14-4, S14-5 and S14-41): blocks 14 to 25 by 3 to 17, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. Heather slopes with bracken in their hollows rise to the summit at block (22, 9), the island's view point, with the watch cairn's plot marked out on it in stones; on the summit's lee the hermit's prayer stone over its cist, its capstone pulled one tile to open it (and pushed back). Kelda's upper stream rises at a spring line at block (21, 13), falls over the lip of the high ground at block (20, 14) (the lip a short face, the falling sheet blocking, its pool knee deep at the edge, a dry ledge behind the sheet reached only by wading the pool's edge), and runs south over the grass towards the Kelda. The north coast is cliff; a rock knoll in the south-west corner closes the gap of decision S14-4. Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
